# CLAUDE.md rule 6: no competitor's name appears anywhere in the tree.
#
# One name per line; blank lines and # comments are ignored. Matched on WORD
# BOUNDARIES, because a plain substring match fails forever on a coincidence --
# a minified Sentry helper contains one of these inside a longer identifier,
# which is what docs/BUILD-REPORT.md gap 9 records.
#
# This file is excluded from its own scan. A gate that cannot state what it
# looks for without failing itself is a gate nobody can run, and both the audit
# skill and the first version of the CI step tripped exactly that way.
